title: Chapter 169
text:
Han Xiao had foreseen such a situation. Everyone would be able to learn [Energy Training Technique] the first time they advanced, but the players did not know about it. For players who were currently LV 8 or 9, this was a godly skill. The increase in energy was more than what they gained from leveling up. Some players had not even changed their main class, so they needed skills that increased energy.

Blue Star was the base camp of the Chinese players. Han Xiao seemed to be cheating the players by teaching them a skill that they were bound to learn, but in reality, that was not the case. One had to know that if they had a small advantage in the early stages, it would snowball and grow stronger.

Looking at it from another perspective, Han Xiao allowed players around LV 10 to learn a skill that could only be learned by LV 20 players. Thinking about it this way, his actions were a win-win situation.

Not only would he earn a huge amount of EXP, but he would also allow the Chinese players to be ahead of the players from other planets.

"Perfect."

Han Xiao was very satisfied with his plan. Why would he cheat the players? It was all the prejudice and misunderstanding that the world had about him. He loved his country so much. Back then, his father had almost named him Xiao Aiguo or Xiao Zhenbang, but he had changed his name under the pressure of the tigress.

[Energy Training Technique] required 10,000 EXP to learn, and the profit it contained made Han Xiao's heart beat violently just thinking about it. He could only teach the players the [Energy Training Technique] before they advanced for the first time. This was a one-time deal, and he would take as much as he could. According to the enthusiasm of the players, Han Xiao felt that the EXP he would receive in Version 1.0 would be an astronomical figure.

While he was running to the Western Continent's Novice Village, Pork Bun finally released the first video on the forum.

Galaxy Adventure Diary: Black Phantom (1)

…

Pork Bun's Dog was quite famous. Once the video was released, there were hardcore fans and curious passers-by who clicked on it.

"Finally released a new episode. It's an international practice. Hurry up before you watch it!"

"Missing People Come Back to Life!"

"The title is Black Phantom. Is Pork Bun riding on Black Phantom's coattails?"

The program was posted in the video section of the forum. The forum was not only for chatting, but it also had other functions. In order to let the players pass the time while they were playing the game, the video section had a lot of traffic. With the addition of the old fans, the number of viewers kept increasing.

The opening was an edited promotional video with some screenshots of the scenery. When the movie started, the first thing that appeared was a third-person view of Pork Bun Dog. This was a viewing function that came with the game, so one could check the appearance of the movie. The background was the Black Pine Settlement. Pork Bun Dog waved at the camera and opened his mouth to recite a poem.

"The Boundless Heaven and Earth give birth to the universe, and Yin and Yang give birth to all living beings. Every moment of the night is worth a thousand pieces of gold. Welcome to the diary of a space adventure. I am Pork Bun."

The bullet screen was filled with ridicule.

"Is this a prelude? It must be an introductory poem! "

"At that time, I recited a line from a poem, 'Coward …'"

"The sun rises in the east, only I am undefeated. Long live the Clam God Sect!"

In the program, Pork Bun continued, "It has been a long time since I released a new work. As the first episode of the Galaxy series, I will use a character as a cutting point of view to bring everyone to experience my adventure. This character has left a lot of impressions on the players. Mechanic class teacher, novice guide, mysterious NPC, hidden story. I think the audience in front of the screen will be curious about the identity of this character. That's right, he is the person written in the title — Black Phantom!"

The bullet screen: "Wow, awkward chat time, I f * cking admire you!"

The camera changed to Pork Bun's first-person view, and the official content started.

The content of the video was all recorded by Pork Bun while he was beating Dog. After editing, it was made into different segments. The special effects and narration were added later. Pork Bun followed the humorous style and started from the scene where he met Han Xiao for the first time. Han Xiao fought against the wolves in Green Valley Town and stopped the confrontation between the two warlords. Pork Bun showed the first-person view of the game while he beat Dog. The narration started to analyze Han Xiao's influence.

"Forcing two warlords to retreat with a single sentence, Black Phantom has shown his influence. Before analyzing, I think we should introduce the identity of the warlords first …" The scene changed to Black Pine Settlement. Bun-hit-dog introduced Lu Cheng as the leader of this large settlement with a large number of troops and chariots. Then, the topic changed.

"Lu Cheng has such a large force, but he is still afraid of Black Phantom. Then, where does Black Phantom's influence come from? Listen to me, Brother Bao." He used Lu Cheng as a foundation to further arouse the audience's curiosity about Black Phantom. The effect was obvious.

Mad Blade and Angry Sword appeared in the show as guests. The analysis of Han Xiao's identity started from the conversation between the two of them, slowly revealing the tip of the iceberg of Black Phantom's mysterious origin.

First, the two of them revealed Black Phantom's name. It seemed to be Han Xiao, and he used to serve in Stardragon's intelligence agency. This was information that no one knew, and it caught the audience's attention instantly. The bullet screen became much smaller, and the audience was watching the content seriously.

Mad Blade was riding on Han Xiao's coattails during the closed beta, but he had no idea about Han Xiao's real identity. He only knew that Black Phantom originally belonged to the Six Nations. For some unknown reason, Black Phantom left Stardragon and joined the Dark Net and Blood Pact Society. This information came from a strong enemy (Liu Cheng) who was also [Extremely Deadly]. Although the details of these two organizations were not known, they definitely had a strong background. They were high-level organizations that players could not come into contact with at the moment, and they were also one of the sources of Black Phantom's influence.

Pork Bun and Mad Blade also thought that the key reason why people were afraid of Black Phantom was because of his strength. At the players' level, they could not see the exact attributes of high-level characters, but they had seen Han Xiao kill other [Extremely Deadly] NPCs more than once. Just based on this, they believed that Black Phantom's strength was at the top level among NPCs!

Going against the Germinal Organization was Black Phantom's biggest goal at the moment. As there were not many clues, they could not figure out the reason why Black Phantom and the Germinal Organization were at odds. Mad Blade shared the situation of the closed beta. From the closed beta to the open beta, more than three months had passed in the game, and Han Xiao had turned into Black Phantom. Once this information was released, it immediately aroused the audience's curiosity.

What exactly did he go through to become the Black Phantom of today?

There was no evidence, so it was all speculation. The show did not talk about it in detail. Pork Bun's original intention was to throw this question out as the 'hook' and 'suspense' of the show to attract the audience's curiosity.

Then, Pork Bun and Mad Blade discussed Black Phantom's actions in the Novice Village. They thought that this was the decisive evidence to prove that Black Phantom was the Novice Guide. After more than twenty days of playing, the players realized that the NPCs' actions and thoughts were very 'real'. They would even be surprised that the players could come back from the dead. Then, why would Black Phantom come into contact with the players so frequently, and it was obvious that he had a plan? There must be a special reason, but the show only mentioned it briefly.

Pork Bun said that he and Mad Blade had both triggered Black Phantom's hidden storyline, proving that he could follow and report. At the same time, he introduced the various benefits of Black Phantom and recorded the scene of Han Xiao giving Mad Blade and Angry Sword two high-quality guns. They also followed Black Phantom to Black Pine, a map that was more advanced than the Novice Village, and they could receive missions with rich rewards.

The screen was full of people showing off their benefits, and the audience was very envious. Those who could trigger Black Phantom's hidden storyline were all lucky kings!

"Eat the spear, you bastard!"

"Suck —"

"I heard that you have to hold it in your mouth to be lucky, I …"

At the end of the show, Pork Bun said, "… There is only one episode of the Black Phantom series for now. The next episode may be about something else. After all, Mad Blade and I are now in Black Pine. But don't worry, I will continue to follow and explore Black Phantom's past and present life. So, to all the dog viewers, let's meet again in the next episode!"

The audience who watched the show in one breath only had one thought.

Amazing!

The screen was Bun-hit-dog's first-person adventure, and the commentary at the side was from Black Phantom's perspective. It introduced a lot of information that normal people would not know and threw out more world backgrounds and anecdotes. There was a lot of solid information, and it answered a lot of questions.

Also, the style was relaxed, and it was imaginative, and it came up with all kinds of interesting speculations. The audience was very satisfied and went to other posts to recommend it, making more players join in.

Pork Bun's first episode's theme was very good. It happened to be when Han Xiao stepped into the Western Continent and made his presence known on the forum, and it was at the peak of popularity. Pork Bun's video gained a wave of popularity, and the number of viewers was increasing every second.

The first episode was completely popular!

Pork Bun was very surprised. It was a very good decision to choose the theme for this episode.

The video became popular because of Han Xiao's popularity, and not only that, but it also helped and increased Han Xiao's popularity.
